### [`frdc model convert`](@id ref-model-convert)

Convert a handle between formats (.fmod/.jls/.jld2/archive#key/session URI -> .jld2 or .jls) preserving note & provenance

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `path` | `String` | yes | — | Source handle path (.fmod, .jls, .jld2, archive.jld2#key, or session URI) |

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Destination handle path (e.g. modern.jld2 or out.jls) |
| `--to` | — | `String` | `""` | ``, `jld2`, `jls` | Target format when deriving path or adding extension: jld2\|jls |
| `--note` | — | `String` | `""` | — | Optional note override (default: preserve source handle note) |
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | table\|csv\|json |

**Output tables:** `model_convert_summary` (Source, destination, formats, model type, note and provenance preservation status)

### [`frdc model info`](@id ref-model-info)

Header-only handle inspection (.jld2 native/plain, .jls, .fmod, #key, session URIs): type, versions, dimensions, provenance

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `path` | `String` | yes | — | Path to .jld2/.jls/.fmod handle (with optional #key) or session URI |

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Export results to file |
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | table\|csv\|json |

| Flag | Short | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| `--deep` | — | Opt into full deserialization to compute dimensions on legacy handles lacking _frdc_meta |
| `--keys` | — | List selectable #key entries in multi-key .jld2 or bundle archives |

**Output tables:** `model_handle_info` (Handle path, magic, model type, writing and runtime versions, dimensions, kind, provenance); `model_keys` (Archive/bundle keys when --keys is passed)

### [`frdc model reproduce`](@id ref-model-reproduce)

Verify a saved handle by re-running its estimator from recorded seed/provenance across .jld2, .jls, .fmod, and session URIs

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `path` | `String` | yes | — | Handle path (.jld2, .jls, .fmod, or session URI) |

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--model` | — | `String` | `""` | — | Optional source model handle for two-argument reproduce (e.g. bootstrap ImpulseResponse) |
| `--tol` | — | `Float64` | `1.0e-10` | — | Numeric equality tolerance for CLI-derived comparisons |
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Export results to file |
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | table\|csv\|json |

**Output tables:** `model_reproduce_summary` (Handle, model type, format, match verdict, max_abs_diff, recorded seed, source command, tolerance, thread counts, note); `model_reproduce_fields` (Per-field re-run comparison (present when the report has field diffs))
